name: Siege Tower Feather Token
body:
Price 1000 gp

DESCRIPTION

This token creates a Huge siege tower (see Siege Engines). The tower disappears after 1 hour.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells major creation, telekinetic assembly
